# DigitalX Solutions

> Custom CRM Development & AI Automation Engineering — Australia & United States

## About & Company Facts
DigitalX Solutions is a custom CRM engineering, AI voice telephony, and workflow automation consultancy founded in 2020, serving Australian and US businesses. We engineer hybrid Next.js and PostgreSQL CRM portals, self-hosted n8n workflows, GoHighLevel systems, and low-latency AI voice telephony.

- **Entity**: DigitalX Solutions (Founded 2020)
- **Leadership**: Jazib Shahid, Founder & Lead Solutions Architect
- **Service Area**: Serving Australian and US businesses
- **Phone**: +61 451 413 786
- **Email**: info@digitalx-solutions.com
- **Website**: https://digitalx-solutions.com
- **Structured Facts Page**: https://digitalx-solutions.com/facts

## Core Value Proposition & Positioning
- **Proprietary & Hybrid CRM Engineering**: Eliminating recurring per-seat SaaS taxes ($0 seat fees) with 100% source code and database ownership.
- **Modern Full-Stack Architecture**: Next.js 15, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL/Supabase paired with carrier-grade telephony (Twilio SIP, Vapi) and workflow backends (self-hosted n8n).
- **Illustrative 3-Year TCO Model**: Modeled 60%+ lower 3-year total cost of ownership ($12,100–$24,000 vs. $77,000–$123,000+ illustrative estimate for a 20-user team at $100–$150/seat/mo + onboarding over 36 months).
- **Zero Carrier Markup**: Direct SIP trunking and carrier pass-through pricing with 0% markup on Twilio telephony rates.

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. Custom CRM Development & Architecture
- **CRM Setup & Integration** ($2,200 one-time, 2–3 weeks): Full GoHighLevel or HubSpot setup, bidirectional calendar and dispatch sync, custom webhook routing, 100% client-owned accounts.
- **Hybrid Custom CRM Build** ($8,500 one-time, 3–6 weeks): Bespoke Next.js/React portal + PostgreSQL database combined with GHL/HubSpot CRM APIs, role-based access control (RBAC), legacy data migration, and live telephony sync. 100% source code ownership.
- **Proprietary / White-Label CRM** ($15,000+ custom scope, 6–10 weeks): Multi-tenant SaaS architecture, Stripe usage and subscription billing, dedicated cloud infrastructure, executive analytics, and CI/CD pipelines.

### 2. AI Voice & Workflow Automation Retainers
- **Missed-Call Recovery** ($295/mo): Local operators & solo trades. Instant missed-call text-back (<60s), 10DLC A2P brand registration, two-way SMS triage, and staff lead routing.
- **Launch** ($750/mo): Solo operators & boutique practices. Inbound AI voice agent, missed-call text-back, GoHighLevel CRM setup, calendar sync, up to 300 included call minutes.
- **Operate** ($1,500/mo): Multi-location & high-volume service businesses. Inbound + outbound AI voice, Web + WhatsApp + SMS chatbot, multi-step nurture, ROI dashboard, up to 1,000 call minutes.
- **Scale** (Custom): Growth teams running Meta + Google Ads ops, server-side CAPI tracking, custom n8n workflows, and a dedicated growth engineer.

### 3. Workflow Automation & Integration
- **Self-Hosted & Cloud n8n**: Complex, multi-step business process orchestration with zero per-task execution fees.
- **GoHighLevel System Builds**: Master snapshots, 10DLC A2P brand registration, automated dispatch synchronization, and staff training.
- **HubSpot RevOps**: Custom object modeling, bi-directional pipeline sync, and lifecycle stage automation.

## Shipped Software & Flagship Builds
- **Smart Property Buying AI Research Engine** (https://digitalx-solutions.com/case-studies/smart-property-buying): Automated Australian property stocklist harvesting across 14+ builder portals, Playwright session automation, RapidOCR + PyMuPDF parsing for image-only price PDFs, PropTrack benchmarking, 100-point buyer-brief scoring, and Kommo CRM sync.
- **DigitalX Custom CRM** (https://digitalx-solutions.com/case-studies/digitalx-custom-crm, product overview at https://digitalx-solutions.com/products/digitalx-crm): Proprietary Next.js App Router, Prisma, and PostgreSQL/Supabase CRM with 20 operational modules, AU/US lead pipelines, RBAC role controls, labor-margin analytics, and 4 REST webhook ingestion endpoints (/api/webhooks/ghl, /apollo, /meta-ads, /n8n).
- **Links 2000 Calibration LIMS** (https://digitalx-solutions.com/case-studies/links-2000-lims): Enterprise ISO/IEC 17025:2017 calibration LIMS migrated from legacy VB6/SQL Server to React 19, Vite, Django REST Framework, and Supabase PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security.
